info.name: Haranir
info.description: The Haranir species from World of Warcraft (Andrey Kuzinskiy).
info.author: Andrey Kuzinskiy (book), converted by Kaya Acarbay

description.p: Haranir are reclusive people who dwell in the magical forests of Harandar, a subterranean realm where the roots of the World Trees grow together. Their ancient druidic traditions connect them to the earth and teach them to protect the roots that reach into the deep places where they dwell.

Haranir have little contact with the surface world and its peoples, and they are reluctant to share the details of their traditions with strangers. They have long avoided even allowing other peoples to know of their existence, striving to stay out of sight and conceal traces of their presence.

Haranir bear a passing resemblance to both night elves and trolls. They have tusks (smaller than trolls’), bat-like ears, and grayish-purple skin with patches of fur or sharp quills. They tend to favor clothing made from leaves and thorns.
You have no starting Renown Score.
As a Haranir, you have these special traits.
Darkvision. You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.
Gift of the World Trees. Because of your supernatural connection to the world trees, you have proficiency in the Nature and Survival skills.

Haranir Magic. You know the Druidcraft and Thorn Whip cantrips. When you reach character level 3, you learn the Entangle spell. You always have it prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. When you reach character level 5, you also always have the Spike Growth spell prepared and can cast it the same way. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select this species).
You know Common (Alliance) or Orcish (Horde), plus two languages from the Alliance Languages or Horde Languages tables. At least one of Common or Orcish is recommended.
